# gpcloud_item (Resource)

Manages a GPCloud item.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gpcloud_item" "example" {
  name = "hello"
}

output "item_id" {
  value = gpcloud_item.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the item.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the item, derived from its name.
